messages:
miko: FYI — hedgehog LoRA merge on cust-hedgehog produced diffy completions after int4 quant. Seeing token shifts mid-sentence. Repro on our smoke harness.

liam: ran a quick run, confirmed. outputs diverge at step ~42, likely kv-cache/offset mismatch after tokenizer remap. Pasting mini log:

```
INPUT: "Invoice total:"
GOLD: "... $1,234.56"
MERGED_INT8: "... $1,23"
TOKEN_IDS_GOLD: [101, 567, 2034, ...]
TOKEN_IDS_MERGED: [101, 567, 203, 4, ...]
```

anna: is this only when running with prefix caching + batching? or also single-stream?

miko: repros in single-stream with kv cache enabled. If kv cache disabled, outputs align. So it's kv-state related.

sam: uploaded quick eval pack: https://internal.artifacts/redwood/evals/hedgehog_smoke_200.json with 200 examples including currency/number formats. Summary:
- baseline (float16): pass rate 98%
- lora-merged, no quant: 97%
- lora-merged, int4: 84% (token split errors ~10%)
- int8: 90%

Looks like quant + merged weights amplifies tokenizer boundary splits.

tara: could be tokenizer vocab indices differing between patched tokenizer and runtime. Any custom token maps from hedgehog?

liam: customer supplied a tokenizer remap during finetune (merge step). Our merge applies remap but quant kernels use fast path that assumes stable token->id mapping. Investigating.

miko: proposed short fixes:
1) Add sanity check during merge that token id map is identity or produce remap table.
2) Force slow kv-copy path for remapped tokens in quant runtimes as temporary.
3) Re-run eval pack and schedule canary.

sam: can we get a quick patch that detects tokenmap delta and logs a metric? we can ship without perf regresses.

infra-bot: deploy started by @sam for team/merge-hotfix -> staging at 1732468500

liam: small diff to runtime: in kv_cache_write(), check token remap flag and fall back. I'll open PR.

miko: PR link: https://git.re/redwood/infer/pulls/4567

anna: after PR, run eval pack & share numbers here. also cc @customer-success to notify hedgehog.

tara: pinging cs: @jordan can you flag customer and ask for their tokenizer artifacts?

jordan: will do. asking for tokenizer.json + merge metadata. ETA 2h.

miko: thanks. adding test to harness that simulates remap + int4 quant path so this doesn't regress.

liam: rolled patch to staging, running smoke eval now.

sam: smoke quick numbers (staging): int4 with patch: pass rate 92% (was 84%). still some edge cases but huge improvement. scheduling canary to prod next week behind dedicated traffic routing.

miko: moving to create follow-up tasks: - add tokenmap diff metric - formal canary plan - messenger to hedgehog w/ETA

liam: note for postmortem: root cause likely assumption in quant kernel about contiguous token id slices during kv write when using packed tokens. We'll add a unit test.

miko: thanks all :thumbsup:
